title: Oracle Fusion Financials Technical Consultant
teaser: Join our team as a Oracle Fusion Financials Technical Consultant, where you will build and support integrations between Oracle Fusion and external applications, and support the Month End close process. Ideal candidates have extensive experience with Oracle Fusion Financials and strong technical expertise in Oracle Fusion modules.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 08/24/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team 

Cisco IT is a transformation engine enabling people to do the best work of their lives! Our vision is to be loved as the world’s best IT organization. We lead with user experience, accept agile ways of working, drive engineering efficiency, and deliver with Cloud first, shift left, AI powered technology.

The Component Operations Supply Chain IT team is at the forefront of transforming our supply chain through technology. We specialize in implementing and optimizing our Supply Chain ERP solution, a critical backbone for managing everything from procurement to delivery. Our expertise ensures seamless integration of processes, providing real-time visibility and control over our entire supply chain operations. We empower data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve overall operational agility. 

Your Impact:

We are looking for 7+ years of hands-on experience working with Oracle Fusion Financials and possess strong technical expertise in Oracle Fusion data models, integrations, reporting, and security.

Build and support integrations between Oracle Fusion and external applications using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, FBDI,UCM, and ESS Jobs.

Support the Month End close process for Account  Payables, Procurement, Costing and General Ledger

Develop, customize, and support Oracle Fusion Financials technical solutions.

Design, develop, and optimize SQL queries for reporting, data extraction, perform SQL performance tuning and troubleshooting for Oracle Fusion data models.

Support technical design, development, testing, and deployment activities.

Collaborate with functional consultants to understand business requirements and deliver scalable technical solutions.

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Oracle Fusion Financials.

Minimum Qualification

4-8 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials.

Strong technical knowledge of the following Oracle Fusion modules:

                  •           General Ledger (GL)

                  •           Accounts Payable (AP)

                  •           Procurement

                  •           Cost Management (Costing)

                  •           Subledger Accounting (SLA)

Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials data models and database architecture.

Experience in working and resolving issues during the Month End close for Account Payables,Procurement,Costing and General Ledger

Expertise in Oracle SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.

Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, FBDI,UCM, and ESS Jobs for integrations.

Good understanding of Oracle Fusion security concepts, including Security Roles, Data Access Sets, Duty Roles, and Job Roles.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with BI Publisher and OTBI reporting.

Knowledge of SOAP web services and FBDI.

Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Exposure to Oracle Fusion Redwood UX and modern Oracle Cloud technologies is an added advantage.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
